title: Kyber don release version 0.26
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: Our version 0.26 don land, e carry 3 big updates: clipboard wey don beta pass before, OpenID Connect, and media pipeline wey dem don optimize well-well, plus plenty small-small improvement.
html:
Kyber 0.26 don land!

Kyber 0.26 don comot.

Dis release carry plenti beta tins: support for OIDC authentication, big improvement for encoding, clipboard wey don beta for all di platforms, new grabbing backends for Linux, and long list of fixes wey go make di whole desktop stack stand gidigba.

See di main tins wey dey inside.

OIDC support

Kyber now dey support OpenID Connect (OIDC) for authentication, for both kycontroller and di desktop client. You fit join Kyber with di identity provider setup wey you don already get, weda na Keycloak, Auth0, Authelia, or any oda SSO system wey follow di standard.

Dis one na big step for organisations wey dey run Kyber for place wey plenti users dey or for big company environment, where to manage identity from one central place na must.

Clipboard don beta

For dis release, di way Kyber dey handle clipboard don move forward well-well. Linux X11 hosts fit now share clipboard, and for Windows, full HTML clipboard support don join di plain-text clipboard wey we bring before. Rich content — text wey get style, links, and data wey dem don format — you fit now copy and paste am across machines for Windows, just like say na di same machine you dey use.

Video encoding don improve

We don upgrade kymedia go FFmpeg 8.1, wey carry all di latest codec improvements, bug fixes, and beta speed from upstream.

Di encode settings for AMF (AMD) and VAAPI don improve well-well, and e dey really reduce latency. AMD users especially go feel di difference: encoding latency don near wetin you go expect from Nvidia.

For Windows, kymedia/vlc now dey use di standard Microsoft GUID for HEVC 4:2:2 and 4:4:4 chroma subsampling, instead of di one wey be only for Intel. Dis one go work with more kain hardware devices and e dey more reliable for real life.

New screen capture backends for Linux

kymedia don get two new grab_backend options: xcb and wlroots. Linux users now get native capture support for both X11 and wlroots (Wayland) ecosystems, so e go work with more kain desktop environments.

WebSocket controller now dey use kycom

controller/ws now dey use kycom take communicate with kyavserver and kynput, instead of di direct communication wey e dey use before. Dis one make am follow di same pattern with di rest of di stack.

Fixes for stability

Some fixes dey wey settle edge cases wey fit make di app crash, dey restart non-stop, or fail anyhow wey go confuse pesin:

kycontroller/win32 : If tray icon no gree start, e no go kill di app again. Kyber go recover jeje wen e receive di TaskbarCreated message, so e go work well even if Explorer restart or di taskbar slow to show.

kyservice/win32 : Di service no go dey loop non-stop again wen e jam configuration wey no correct.

kycontroller : Di number of clients wey dey show for tray now dey update well wen session time out.

kycontroller : Di watchdog don become optional, you fit use am or leave am.

kycontroller : We don fix di RTP backend. E bin quietly stop to work afta we add IPv6 support for 0.25.0.

Scancode conversion helpers don dey for all platforms

kynput now dey export scancode conversion helpers for all platforms. Dis one go help integrators wey need make scancode work di same way, no mata di OS wey dem dey target.

Web: new branding and AV player refactor

Di web UI don come with di new Kyber branding. For kyctl side, we don comot di AV players put dem for separate crates, so e go dey easier to maintain and expand di codebase from now on.

Upgrade

Kyber 0.26 don dey available now. Go di downloads page to get di latest version, or pull di updated packages through di channel wey you dey use before.

We dey welcome your feedback and bug reports.
